name: NÜRNBERGER Beteiligungs-AG
summary: NÜRNBERGER Beteiligungs-AG operates as an insurance company in Germany. The company offers career and pension products, including disability, dread disease, accident, and basic disability insurance; term life and funeral insurance; classic and unit-linked pension insurance, and company pension scheme; and disability, supplementary and professional liability insurance. It also provides health insurance, such as dental, seeing and hearing, international health, supplementary hospital, and private health insurance, as well alternative medicine, sickness benefit, all-round protection, and prevention and vaccinations; nursing care insurance comprising daily care allowance, care provision, and car…
